capability: Study notes checked against each other where they overlap
title: Notes must agree at the joins.

hook.picture: Close on the whale writing a note card from chapter two onto the line. Far down the line sits a chapter-nine card about the same word. Their two little arrows point different ways.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: My notes from chapter two and chapter nine disagree.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: a learner the night before the exam

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: a long line of cards from a 600-page book. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a new card lands far from its twin and the pod flashes ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: No one reads both pages side by side.

stakes.body: You revise the wrong version, lose marks, and stop trusting your own notes.

solution_hint: Check each note where it meets another.

metaphor.body: Each chapter note is a card on one line. Wherever two cards cover the same idea, a seam joins them. It is read from both sides, and it glows when they disagree.

steps.picture: The whale slides the two cards end to end. Where both cover the same word, a dashed join appears, with one chevron reading each side.
steps.words: Check each note where it meets another.
steps.sound: Two tones, one per card, struck together.

steps.picture: Every pair of cards sharing a word gets a dashed join. Each join is read both ways. Most turn teal with a soft tick.
steps.words: Read both ends of every join.
steps.sound: Unison pairs ring, one per teal join.

steps.picture: Push-in on the chapter two and nine join: it glows copper. The whale erases neither card. Both stay, and the join stays lit.
steps.words: This one disagrees. It stays lit.
steps.sound: The pair beats, detuned, with the glow.

steps.picture: The learner fixes the card that misread its page; both ends move to meet and the join turns teal. A label slides onto it: seam.
steps.words: Where two notes meet: a seam.
steps.sound: The two tones glide into one note.

real_case.claim: sheaf-knowledge-studio built a page-cited study base from Marinov (377 pp., 291 declarations); all 3 builds cleared 30/30 binary gates.

honest_limit.picture: Push into one teal join: both cards carry the same misreading, copied from one page. The join agrees and turns teal anyway. The pod reads it and answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: Both notes copied one mistake. It passes.

not_this.body: Agreeing notes can share one mistake.

ending_pattern.body: The cards of a whole course fold shut into one bound book whose spine carries a tick, and the exam pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The two cards that disagreed in bar 1 sit in the same framing, joined teal, inside one bound book.

end_belief.body: Compare notes where they overlap. Keep the warnings.

sound.signature: Each join is two struck tones that ring in unison when the cards agree.
sound.problem_motif: The same two tones a quarter-tone apart, beating like a wrong chord.

score_self.reason: Pain and move read clearly from pictures. The case card says declarations, which a learner may not parse. The limit (a shared mistake) is shown, not just said.
